_about: The rated index. Scores are EDITORIAL (does this measurably improve outcomes when composed into a harness?), never install counts. last_verified = the date a human/agent actually checked the thing still exists and ships. Entries decay: anything unverified for 30+ days gets flagged by research_update.py.

entries.name: anthropics/skills: frontend-design
entries.install: claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills && claude plugin install frontend-design
entries.why: The single biggest visible-quality jump for web output; kills the generic AI aesthetic at the source.

entries.name: obra/superpowers
entries.why: The process backbone: brainstorming gates, test-driven loops, verification-before-completion. Discipline as an install.

entries.name: playwright MCP
entries.why: Gives the agent eyes. Every design loop depends on it; the highest-leverage single install for visual work.

entries.name: humanizer
entries.why: Strips AI-writing tells systematically. The difference between content people read and content people clock.

entries.name: remotion skill
entries.why: Video as React code: the only path where a coding agent controls every frame, which makes the design loop possible for video.

entries.name: anthropics/skills: pptx
entries.why: Real PowerPoint generation that survives editing afterward; the deck harness's production layer.

entries.name: anthropics/skills: pdf + docx
entries.install: claude plugin install pdf && claude plugin install docx
entries.why: Real document formats instead of markdown cosplay; the document harness's production layer.

entries.name: agent-reach
entries.why: 15-platform reach (X, Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn, xiaohongshu...): pulls the community layer most research runs silently skip.

entries.name: wshobson/agents
entries.why: Battle-tested subagent patterns for parallel sweeps and synthesis; the research harness's fan-out layer.

entries.name: GSAP skills (core + ScrollTrigger)
entries.why: Motion that feels engineered. The gap between a static AI page and a site with craft is usually motion.

entries.name: context7 MCP
entries.why: Current library docs on demand; stops the agent from writing against a framework version that no longer exists.

entries.name: ffmpeg
entries.why: Every video path terminates in ffmpeg: concat, mux, convert, extract stills for the frame loop.

entries.name: Vercel deploy (CLI or MCP)
entries.why: The shortest reliable path from local build to live URL; the ship phase's default.

entries.name: ElevenLabs TTS
entries.install: API key at elevenlabs.io (free tier exists)
entries.why: The AI-voiceover default: quality high enough that VO stops being the tell. Costs money beyond free tier; the estimate flags it.

entries.name: spec-kit
entries.why: The biggest spec-driven-development framework (~80k stars). For software builds beyond our web-app scope; indexed so the composer can hand off when someone's real ask is 'build me an app'.

entries.name: BMAD-METHOD
entries.why: Persona-agent development methodology (~37k stars). Powerful and heavy: hundreds of millions of tokens/week on real projects. Indexed for awareness; we deliberately compose lighter.

entries.name: davila7/claude-code-templates
entries.why: ~1,000-component parts store (agents, commands, hooks, MCPs) with a clean CLI. Our closest neighbor; useful raw material, no composition or process layer.

entries.name: skills.sh registry
entries.why: The install rail everything ships on, with install-count leaderboards. Popularity signal only; our ratings layer sits on top of it.

entries.name: firecrawl MCP
entries.install: claude mcp add firecrawl -- npx -y firecrawl-mcp
entries.why: Structured scraping for sweep lanes when plain fetch hits JS-rendered walls. Free tier exists; paid beyond.

entries.name: Gemini image gen (Vertex AI)
entries.install: gcloud auth application-default login, then REST to gemini-3-pro-image
entries.why: Current best quality-per-cent for still generation (~$0.13/2K image); the visual pipeline default where a harness needs original imagery.

entries.name: Lighthouse CI
entries.why: The ship gate's objective half: performance and accessibility scored, not vibed.
